expected_behavior: The zsh script that `hermes completion zsh` prints completes `hermes <TAB>` on the first TAB when saved as `_hermes` in an fpath directory.
The same script still registers the completer when sourced with `eval "$(hermes completion zsh)"`, and runs no completion code while it is sourced.
The first line stays `#compdef hermes`, and every pinned test in tests/hermes_cli/test_completion.py still passes.
